say:0:1120312001:0.text: You settlement is blessed, I must say! No wonder they say great people thrive in great places!
say:0:1120312001:0.source_cn: 没想到，你们氏族的环境这么好！怪不得，人杰地灵啊！

say:1:1120312002:0.text: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!
say:1:1120312002:0.source_cn: 托梅林大人的福，我们这群小蛮血才能生存下来！
say:1:1120312002:0.male: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!
say:1:1120312002:0.female: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!

say:2:1120312003:0.text: Let's go check on the little Mauler.
say:2:1120312003:0.male: Let's go check on the little Mauler.
say:2:1120312003:0.female: Let's go check on the little Mauler.
